snippet.title: Cross Quest - Trailer
snippet.description:
In a lone nation recognized as 'Summer Island', the young half-human-half-dragon, STEVE CROSS, is chosen by the Summer King to slay an ancient, evil beast known as the 'CHANDELIER SERPENT'. Meet many of the strange inhabitants of the Summer Island, as well as the dangerous beasts Steve must survive against, while he discovers the hidden secrets regarding what his quest truly entails. Awaken mysterious abilities, and collect precious valuables that aid Steve and his journey to rid of the chaos plaguing his homelands, and find sacred peace through it all.

Made with RPGMaker MZ 

=GAME BY ASCENDBAT=
Music by Lithoan: https://lithoan.bandcamp.com/

Itch.io: https://ascendbat.itch.io/cross-quest
Steam: COMING SOON
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/ascendbat
